name: gptvis-vchart-workspace
description: Monorepo for the GPT-Vis VChart adapter and its playground.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w gptvis-vchart && npm run dev -w playground
scripts.build: npm run build -w gptvis-vchart && npm run build -w playground
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w gptvis-vchart && npm run build -w gptvis-vchart && npm run typecheck -w playground
